moved.sentence: When SQLite databases sync with a server or between devices, schema migrations must be compatible across all participants — including devices that may be offline during rollout.

judged.note: The condition (syncing with a server or between devices), MUST compatibility across all participants and the offline-during-rollout inclusion are all kept.

moved.sentence: MUST follow these rules for any migration in a sync-capable schema:

judged.note: The MUST lead-in reaches all six listed rules at MUST; the scope is sync-capable schemas or wider (idempotent and transaction rules apply to every migration), which keeps every obligation.

moved.sentence: **Only add columns — never remove or rename without a migration path.** A device on the old schema must be able to sync with the server on the new schema.

judged.note: MUST only add columns, with the migration-path exception, is in the rule, and the reason (old-schema device syncs with new-schema server) is in its rationale entry.

moved.sentence: **New columns MUST have DEFAULT values.** CRDTs and merge logic require all columns to have a known value for all rows, including those written before the migration.

judged.note: MUST DEFAULT values on new columns in sync-capable schemas is kept, and the CRDT/merge-logic reason is in its rationale entry.

moved.sentence: **Migrations MUST be idempotent.** A device may apply the same migration more than once if it reconnects after a partial sync.

judged.note: MUST idempotent is kept (it now covers every migration), and the reason (re-applied after a partial sync) is in its rationale entry.

moved.sentence: **Wrap each migration in a transaction.** A failed migration must leave the database unchanged.

judged.note: Wrapping each migration in a transaction is kept at MUST, and the reason (a failed migration leaves the database unchanged) is in its rationale entry.

moved.sentence: **Test migrations against databases at every previous version.** An offline device may skip multiple versions and apply them in sequence on reconnect.

judged.note: Testing against every previous version is kept at MUST with the sync-capable scope, and the reason (offline devices skip versions) is in its rationale entry.

moved.sentence: **Always back up before migrating on the server side.**

judged.note: "Always back up before migrating on the server side" becomes MUST always, under the sync-capable-schema scope of the source's MUST list.

moved.sentence: **Critical:** Disable foreign keys before the recreate and re-enable after.

judged.note: The "Critical" requirement becomes MUST, and both halves (disable before the recreate, re-enable after) are kept.

moved.sentence: Run `foreign_key_check` before committing to catch any broken references.

judged.note: Running `foreign_key_check` before committing, with its reason (catch broken references), becomes MUST under the source's Critical label, scoped to the table recreate.

moved.sentence: Each migration MUST be wrapped in a transaction and MUST be idempotent (safe to run twice).

judged.note: Both MUSTs, each migration wrapped in a transaction and idempotent (safe to run twice), are kept, one per rule.
